summary: Fix phase1 CI flakes from run 4058: Create VM after New VM from a host view; skip journaling failed default storage when /var/lib/libvirt/images is absent; start libvirt domain listing earlier under ProbeTimeout; give add-host enroll push 45s under race load.

guide.reason: No operator-facing workflow change; default storage still registers when the directory exists, and Create VM still opens from New VM.

api.reason: API impact: none. No Controller↔Core or client API contract changed; RegisterDefaults is host-local journal behavior, UI tab selection on navigation, and add-host client timeout only.

roadmap.reason: CI harness and robustness; no milestone status change.

state.reason: Default local storage registration remains a Core journal record on the pool master when the path exists.
state.recovery: A fresh Controller adopts succeeded (and previously failed) storage registrations from Core inventory/outcomes; a missing path is no longer permanently poisoned by a failed default attempt.

verification.method: Reproduced Gitea run 4058 failures. go test -race for TestReportBoundsManagedLibvirtObservation, TestAddSiteHostSuccess, and RegisterDefaults passed. Prior agent also ran phase1.py --browser successfully.
verification.results: go race agent/controller/vmhost targeted tests ok
